A CONSTANT WORK IN PROGRESS

Nice to have you here.

This is a personal space for curiosity: a place to share projects, think out loud, and keep a record of the things that catch my attention.

I like the idea of an internet with more small, personal corners. Places with a point of view, room for experiments, and something useful to stumble upon.

A few things you’ll find here

Projects is a collection of small tools and experiments. The blog makes room for longer thoughts. The notebook is for everything that hasn’t quite found its shape yet.

Built to stay simple.

Clear type. A little breathing room. Pages that load quickly and read comfortably. The website should get out of the way of what you came to see.
